title: Detection delay and following-session close return
hypothesis: Events with earlier close-confirmed reactions have higher following-session close returns than events with later reactions.

analysis.name: detection_delay_split_following_close_return-v1
analysis.description: Freeze the median development detection delay, then compare mean following-session close return for delays at or below that threshold against later delays without refitting on OOS.

assumptions: The analysis is observational and does not model fills or trading costs.
known_limitations: Small or concentrated earnings cohorts can make group means unstable.
failure_modes: Missing authoritative following-session coverage can leave the sample gate unmet.
